name: Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa
insider_take: This historic adobe-style resort sits on hallowed ground where California's wine country began, built around natural thermal hot springs that have been revered for centuries.
whats_special: The hotel's Willow Stream Spa is fed by geothermal mineral springs that reach temperatures up to 135°F naturally - the same springs that drew Native Americans here over 1,000 years ago. The property also houses the only championship golf course designed by Sam Whiting in Sonoma County, and you're literally minutes from over 400 world-class wineries.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments in the evening to enjoy the thermal pools under the stars, and ask for a vineyard-view room on the upper floors for stunning sunrise views over the Mayacamas Mountains.
dont_miss: The hotel's wine cave dining experience at Santé Restaurant, featuring wines from the historic Sonoma Mission (California's northernmost mission founded in 1823), and the signature "Fire & Ice" treatment at the spa that combines hot stone therapy with the natural mineral pools.
pros: World-class spa featuring natural geothermal mineral springs
Prime location in heart of Sonoma wine country
Historic mission-style architecture with luxury amenities
